I'll pull your current training to see what you're working with. You haven't logged any training yet, so we're starting from scratch. Bigger shoulders come from consistent work on the main movers — overhead press and lateral raises — over weeks and months. You need a program that hits them directly and often enough, with weight that makes you work, plus the food to support growth.

The app can build you a program focused on shoulders. What's your experience level with lifting, and do you have access to a gym or are you training at home?
